dedupe_keys.name: open net zero infrastructure data discovery catalogue

description: Open Net Zero is Icebreaker One’s public metadata catalogue for finding net-zero data across energy, water, transport, finance and the built environment. It is the expanded successor to the Open Energy discovery catalogue. Records expose titles, owners, update dates, descriptions, formats and licence information where known, with filters for open or shared access and sensitivity. The inspected first page includes electricity connection queues, network assets, outage interfaces and aggregate demand. Geographic and temporal coverage are dataset-specific; the catalogue itself is global. Browsing is free, and Icebreaker One’s own outputs default to CC BY 4.0, while indexed datasets retain their providers’ terms. A limitation is that many records have missing licence metadata or require registration at the source; discoverability does not establish permission or availability of the underlying data. Simulation uses include locating compatible infrastructure inputs and tracing access conditions. No related catalogue or first-review record was identified. The catalogue and its public filters were verified, but its tens of thousands of external datasets were not individually reviewed or downloaded.
